prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Can you recommend a popular sparkling wine to raise a glass at a wedding that tastes a little sweet with nuts and honey, costing between 20 and 40 euros?"

List A:
Wine 1: Sparkling Blend, US, $11. Tasting note: "A sweet style of sparkling wine, with brisk acidity framing orange, lime, vanilla and honey flavors. Nice with wedding cake, at a good price."
Wine 2: Sparkling Blend, US, $27. Tasting note: "A beautifully drinkable rosé sparkling wine for opening now. It's soft and honeyed, with fine bubbles framing slightly sweet flavors of raspberries, cherries, brioche, vanilla and toast."
Wine 3: Sparkling Blend, France, price unknown. Tasting note: "A lightly sparkling wine, this is refreshing and softly sweet with notes of honey and delicate acidity. Because it is low alcohol, it makes a delicious apéritif or accompaniment to dessert."
Wine 4: Prosecco, Italy, $13. Tasting note: "Upfront and immediate fragrances of sweet honey and acacia flower make this extremely aromatic.   The wine is bursting with sweet fruit freshness, creamy foam and sweet peach pie. It's also one of the best priced sparklers we've seen this year."
Wine 5: Chenin Blanc, France, $15. Tasting note: "This is a honey and almond-flavored wine. With its light acidity and creamed-apple fruitiness, it is soft with a crisp edge. Drink this attractive sparkling wine now."

List B:
Wine 1: Chardonnay, Italy, $29. Tasting note: "Here's a stunning sparkling wine made in the classic method, with no added dosage. It offers citrus, melon, apple, stone fruit, minerality and walnut notes. The creamy palate is supported by crisp freshness and finishes bone-dry."
Wine 2: Sparkling Blend, France, price unknown. Tasting note: "A lightly sparkling wine, this is refreshing and softly sweet with notes of honey and delicate acidity. Because it is low alcohol, it makes a delicious apéritif or accompaniment to dessert."
Wine 3: White Blend, France, price unknown. Tasting note: "A lightly crisp sparkling wine, given a delicious lift with citrus and mineral components. Floral and fruity, this is fine apéritif wine, just soft enough, an edge of nuts and yeast giving an extra dimension."
Wine 4: Glera, Italy, $18. Tasting note: "Also available in a 187-ml bottle, this refreshing sparkling wine opens with subtle tones of stone fruit and citrus with subtle sweetness on the close. The quality of the perlage is tight and sharp."
Wine 5: Sparkling Blend, US, $28. Tasting note: "Good price for a sparkling wine this delicious and refined. Offers lots of bubbly pleasure, with orange, lime, vanilla, honey and yeasty flavors. Made from Chardonnay and Pinot Blanc."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
